THE CATHEDRAL ENGINE
★
RAISING THE WIRE SKELETON…
SKELETON STARTS
Whole-cathedral skeletons, standing in wire. Pick one, then change it — every tool works on the skeleton. Slide MATERIALIZE in VIEW to flesh it into stone.
YOUR DESIGNS
THE MODULE M = 8.00 m
One measure governs every dimension of the canon. M = 8.00 m is the published building; any other module transposes it, ratios intact.
ADD A PART
PRESETS
EXEMPLARS
The great plates draw them all to the same scale — so does the sandbox. Exemplars are proportion studies governed by their headline published figures; the ledger keeps auditing against Notre Dame.
Parts land at the plot center, snapped to the 2 m module. Drag any part to move it — it snaps as it goes. Tap a part to select it, then size and format it.

The whole skeleton, sectioned. Isolate a section to work inside it — then pick a figure and drag it onto the ground.

TOOL
STRETCH: drag a part sideways or lengthwise and it extends on that axis. WARP: press on the ground and drag — every part within 16 m leans with your hand, by falloff. The ledger re-measures after every bend, and the canon audit shows the drift.
MATERIALIZE BLUEPRINT HYPERREAL
SUN ANGLE
SCHEME

NAVIGATE—
GYRO CENTER OFF
The gold hub floats at the measured center of the frame, wired to its corners and feet. Drag the hub to turn the whole cathedral; tilt leans it. A building tap settles it level — no measurement is ever taken on a tilt.
THE PIN—
THE BOX—
WIRED NOTES
FRAME RATIO
Ratio φ armed — APPLY rescales every figure and every coordinate about the pinned node, then the ledger re-measures.
AXES + BOX The XYZ frame of the space — shown while you frame, hidden while you work inside it.
THE PLATES Cesariano's geometry over the section, and the perspective masters' triangulated floor.
Your perspective, drawn from your own eye — horizon, vanishing point, distance points, all of it moving as you move.
THE MARIONETTE
SNOW'S RELIQUARY Or tap the crystal floating at the pin.
AUDIO GUIDE
A guide in an Australian voice — three short tracks: the blueprint, your hands, the ledger.
PHASES THE FURNISHING — THE WHOLE CATHEDRAL
Raise it in phases — slide back and the cathedral unmakes itself in reverse order: furnishing, towers, roofs, flyers, vault, glass, triforium, arcade, piers, foundation.
FORCES Vault → flyer → pier → ground, at every bay.
THE GUARD
The guard sleeps. Turn it on and the building answers for its own structure.
SECTION WHOLE
AXIS +0° The liturgical axis — the whole frame turns on its pin; placements stay true.
SUN STUDY 12:00

HISTORY Every change is kept — sixty steps back.
CAMERA

ROTATE SNAP

# THE THREAD, INGESTED — HYBRID
### The Cathedral evening, 2026-10-11, 20:11 → 23:08 CDT · filed as a six-slice hybrid record
### Site: https://snowphamtom.github.io/hall-looks/cathedral/ · Current build: **v45** (commit `408114b`)

---

## SLICE 1 · IDENTITY
One session, one artifact, twenty-six builds. A cathedral sandbox for Greg Simpkins became **a design game based on reality** — generic building types, published dimensions, measured sun — with a resident guide named **Snow** and a game layer drawn entirely from the Core's own mathematics. The thread's through-line: *every claim the page makes is measured, and every refusal it issues is recorded.*

## SLICE 3 · GRADE — the evidence ledger
- **PROVED in-session:** the riddle's door generator regenerates the Core census exactly — **48 masks, 7,140 doors**, sample door (3,13,5,11) valid under the filed predicate (a<b, a+b−c=d, a⊕b=c⊕d, all distinct). The Reuleaux part's constant width: 8.000 in every tested direction (worst 7.996) before shipping.
- **VERIFIED LIVE (bytes + markers on the served page):** every build v20–v45, each by its stamp; v42 additionally verified *zero dead-persona strings serving*; the four v39 guide tracks byte-exact.
- **MEASURED:** the Drive's last-24-hours window (100 items, two waves; 2 Google-native files not content-read — stated at the time); the most-built investigation (27 sources; the like-for-like counts gap named, not papered over); frozen Drive census behind the monetization diagnosis (contracted inbound $0; written pipeline $101.98M at the 2%-of-exposure rule; $214M/yr reconciled to the same rule at 2027 scale).
- **CORRECTED, owned in-thread:** v33's page upload died on a stale grant and never stood alone — its code rode inside v34. The v42 consolidation found a live ghost: Snow's first-touch greeting on-device was still the *Arbiter's* line (capture listeners fire in registration order); removed. The Riddle originally booked the *hidden* door rather than the door actually solved; v44 books the true quartet. An earlier overclaim on the Core exhibit's SHA bookkeeping was likewise corrected in its own thread.
- **UNCONFIRMED — only Taylor's iPhone can settle:** gyro live state, hand tracking, haptic feel, Snow's live speech and track playback, walk-mode feel, and post-v41 boot behavior in his hand (his 21:58 freeze report was the last device report; v41–v45 await his open).
- **REFUSED:** a single headline "anticipated gain" number (no evidence base for close probabilities); calling any self-healing concrete "ours" (none exists in the record — the science is published and was labeled as such); any claim that bytes served equals the module running — the v41 watchdog exists because that distinction failed once.

## SLICE 4 · HOME
Working file `~/workspace/your_files/cathedral_engine/index2.html` (+ `index.html`, `push/index.html` mirrors); backup of the pre-consolidation file kept (`index2_v41_backup.html`); guide tracks `guide0–3.mp3` alongside. Research home: `~/workspace/research_notes/most-built-building-types-20261012-0129/`. Monetization home: `~/workspace/goals/monetize-the-position-strengthen-the-position/`. This digest: `~/workspace/your_files/THREAD_INGEST_HYBRID_2026-10-11.md` (+ iPhone sibling).

## SLICE 5 · PROVENANCE
Every build pushed by browser upload to `snowphamtom/hall-looks` (the connector cannot carry this page; ~127 KB argv ceiling) and verified by polling the Pages URL with `?v=` cache-busters against its BUILD stamp. Standing rules the thread produced or proved: **changes ship live in the turn they are made, stamped** (Taylor, 19:19); **never overwrite a file after spawning its upload** (the grant dies); ** Snow is frozen** — the informant is final (recommendation given 22:54, accepted by the consolidation that followed); **no new features until the structure is honest** (v42 before v43). Voice recordings via TTS from the catalog; v38's mechanical treatment and v39's ethereal treatment are ffmpeg chains, documented in-thread (ring modulation 32/47 Hz; shimmer aeval 56/83 Hz; loudnorm −16 LUFS).

## SLICE 6 · INTERACTION ★
What the thread changed outside itself: the .ART packet must now be **re-aimed** (the domain serves Trains of Thought; deadline **Nov 1**). The DIU window opens **Oct 21–22** (watch live; staged draft unsent). PayPal's $99 fell due **Oct 12** — Taylor's step, unconfirmed. Open offers left standing: GROW mode (self-healing concrete, honestly labeled — unchosen), the reactions re-measurement (Oct 29 — unadopted), the three-minute iPhone smoke pass that would close every UNCONFIRMED line above. The game's own ★ made literal: the Riddle is the canonical line as play — *measure what is left over after an interaction; admit only what fits inside that leftover; otherwise refuse and record the refusal* — the door opens only for the quartet that fits, and every refusal is spoken, haptic, and kept.

﻿""" 
[54,8] Self-Correcting Code on Proved Invertible Layers Coupling: Rigid Frame Payload (F=NP, 48-dim) coupled with Linear  Parity Tail (li-tail, 6-dim) 
Mathematical Structure: 
- Message: m in R^8 
- Frame: R in R^{48x8}, Duffin-Schaeffer tight frame (R^T R = 12  * I_8) 
- Braid: rho in GL_48, Burau representation on B_9 (Fibonacci  word len 62, t = 1/phi) 
- Permutation: pi in S_48, pi(i) = (13 * i) mod 48 (F_7 = 13, inv  = 37) 
- Parity: H in {0,1}^{6x48}, 48 distinct columns, each with  Hamming weight >= 2 
- Tail: t = H @ v_payload in R^6 
- Codeword: c = [v_payload, t] in R^54 
Syndrome & Error Decoupling: 
- Single payload spike: syndrome = e * H[:, j] => weight >= 2,  collinear with H[:, j] 
- Single tail edit: syndrome = -f * e_k => weight == 1  (canonical unit vector) 
- No two payload columns parallel -> unique identification of  payload error. 
- Payload and tail syndrome supports are geometrically disjoint  -> zero false-positive repairs. 
- Dual-error or uncorrectable perturbations -> Rollback & Refuse. """ 
from __future__ import annotations 
import math 
from itertools import product 
from dataclasses import dataclass 
from typing import Tuple, List, Optional 
import numpy as np 
phi = (1 + 5**0.5) / 2 
t = 1 / phi 
TOL = 1e-7 
class InteractionSurplus: 
 @staticmethod
 def Delta(a: float, b: float, lam: float = 0.0) -> float:  return lam * math.sqrt(max(a * b, 0.0)) 
 @staticmethod 
 def S(a: float, b: float, lam: float = 0.0) -> float:  return a + b + InteractionSurplus.Delta(a, b, lam) 
# ---------- Tight Frame ---------- 
def build_R() -> np.ndarray:

def build_full_rig():

        parent.op('GENESIS_7140_TOX').destroy()
    if parent.op('GENESIS_7140'):
        parent.op('GENESIS_7140').destroy()


    base = parent.create(containerCOMP, 'GENESIS_7140_TOX')
    base.nodeX = 0
    base.nodeY = 0
    base.par.w = 1920
    base.par.h = 1080
    base.par.bgcolorr = 0.019
    base.par.bgcolorg = 0.039
    base.par.bgcolorb = 0.078


    nodes_dat = op('/project1/nodes')
    edges_dat = op('/project1/edges')
    if not nodes_dat or not edges_dat:
        debug('Import touchdesigner_nodes.csv as /project1/nodes and touchdesigner_edges.csv as /project1/edges first')
        return


    # --- 1. TABLE CHOPs for instancing ---
    # Convert nodes to CHOP for position
    nodes_dat_to = base.create(datToCHOP, 'nodes_to_chop')
    nodes_dat_to.par.dat = nodes_dat
    nodes_dat_to.nodeX = 0
    nodes_dat_to.nodeY = 0


    # Shuffle for instancing
    # We'll create a CHOP with tx, ty, tz, scale


    # --- 2. GEOMETRY for beam ---
    # Single beam cylinder that will be instanced 1128 times (actually 944 door beams)
    beam_geo = base.create(geoCOMP, 'beam_geo')
    beam_geo.nodeX = 400
    beam_geo.nodeY = 0


    # Cylinder SOP inside
    cyl = beam_geo.create(cylinderSOP, 'cylinder')
    cyl.par.height = 1
    cyl.par.radius = 0.05
    cyl.par.res = 8


    # Phong MAT with constant beam colors locked
    phong = base.create(phongMAT, 'beam_phong')
    phong.par.emit = 1.5
    phong.par.emit2r = 1
    phong.par.emit2g = 1
    phong.par.emit2b = 1
    phong.nodeX = 400
    phong.nodeY = -150


    # Instance MAT switching by class: we will use MAT per instance via instance texture? Simplified: use color CHOP
    beam_geo.par.material = phong


    # --- 3. INSTANCE CHOP ---
    # Build instance transforms from edges DAT
    edge_to = base.create(datToCHOP, 'edges_to_chop')
    edge_to.par.dat = edges_dat
    edge_to.nodeX = 0
    edge_to.nodeY = 150


    # Math CHOPs to create tx,ty,tz from a,b positions
    # Use lookup from nodes: For each edge, tx = (x_a + x_b)/2, ty = (y_a + y_b)/2, tz = 0
    # Scale Y = doors_per_pair / 8.0 (height = door count)
    # We'll create a Script CHOP to compute


    script_chop = base.create(scriptCHOP, 'instance_builder')

    script_code = """
import math


def onCook(scriptOp):
    nodes_dat = op('/project1/nodes')
    edges_dat = op('/project1/edges')
    if not nodes_dat or not edges_dat:
        return
    
    # Build lookup for node positions
    node_pos = {}
    for i in range(1, nodes_dat.numRows):
        mask = int(nodes_dat[i, 'mask'])
        x = float(nodes_dat[i, 'x_pos'])
        y = float(nodes_dat[i, 'y_pos'])
        node_pos[mask] = (x, y)


    num_edges = edges_dat.numRows - 1
    scriptOp.clear()


    # Create channels: tx, ty, tz, sx, sy, sz, cr, cg, cb, alpha
    tx = scriptOp.appendChan('tx')
    ty = scriptOp.appendChan('ty')
    tz = scriptOp.appendChan('tz')
    sx = scriptOp.appendChan('sx')
    sy = scriptOp.appendChan('sy')
    sz = scriptOp.appendChan('sz')
    cr = scriptOp.appendChan('cr')
    cg = scriptOp.appendChan('cg')
    cb = scriptOp.appendChan('cb')
    alpha = scriptOp.appendChan('alpha')


    # Ham colors
    ham_colors = {2:(0.54,0.17,0.89),3:(0.25,0.41,0.88),4:(0.18,0.8,0.44),5:(1.0,0.55,0.0),6:(1.0,0.0,0.0)}
    # Class colors constant locked
    class_colors = {'DOOR': (0.97,0.89,0.55)}


    for i in range(num_edges):
        row = i+1
        try:
            a = int(edges_dat[row, 'a'])
            b = int(edges_dat[row, 'b'])
            ham_v = int(edges_dat[row, 'ham'])
            cnt = int(edges_dat[row, 'doors_per_pair'])
            is_comp = int(edges_dat[row, 'is_complement_128'])
        except:
            continue


        xa, ya = node_pos.get(a, (0.5,0.5))
        xb, yb = node_pos.get(b, (0.5,0.5))


        # Position in world: map 0-1 to -10 to 10
        x_world = ((xa+xb)/2 - 0.5) * 20
        y_world = ((ya+yb)/2 - 0.5) * 20
        z_world = 0


        # Scale: sy = doors_per_pair (constant beam height), sx/sz thin
        scale_y = max(0.2, cnt * 0.3)  # 1-32 -> 0.3-9.6
        scale_xz = 0.08 + (cnt/32.0)*0.12


        # Color: ham + class, constant locked
        r,g,bv = ham_colors.get(ham_v, (0.97,0.89,0.55))
        # If door, blend ham with gold for dual-aspect: bottom=class, tip=ham already via gradient MAT
        # For constant beam, keep ham color as base, but gold tint for door class
        if is_comp:
            r,g,bv = (1,1,1)  # complementary white highlight


        tx[i] = x_world
        ty[i] = scale_y/2  # raise so base at 0
        tz[i] = z_world
        sx[i] = scale_xz
        sy[i] = scale_y
        sz[i] = scale_xz
        cr[i] = r
        cg[i] = g
        cb[i] = bv
        alpha[i] = 0.85


    return
"""


    # Create Text DAT for callback
    callback_dat = base.create(textDAT, 'instance_callback')
    callback_dat.text = script_code
    callback_dat.nodeX = 0
    callback_dat.nodeY = 450


    script_chop.par.callbacks = callback_dat

## Ranked verified quotes (1 = highest value: rarity × depth × postability)

### 1
**Quote:** It were better, indeed, to accept the legends of the gods than to bow beneath that yoke of destiny which the natural philosophers have imposed.
**Philosopher:** Epicurus
**Work + location:** Letter to Menoeceus (in Diogenes Laertius, Lives X)
**Translator / edition:** Robert Drew Hicks; Wikisource text of the Hicks translation
**Source URL:** https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Letter_to_Menoeceus
**Nearby words (proof of page-read):** before: "For he sees that necessity destroys responsibility and that chance or fortune is inconstant" — after: "The one holds out some faint hope that we may escape if we honour the gods"
**Why rare/valuable:** Almost never circulated; flips the usual Epicurean “gods don’t care” into a fierce preference for myth over deterministic chains — compact, shocking, postable.

### 2
**Quote:** How do I know that the love of life is not a delusion? and that the dislike of death is not like a young person's losing his way, and not knowing that he is (really) going home?
**Philosopher:** Zhuangzi (Kwang-dze / Chuang Tzu)
**Work + location:** Book II (Khî Wû Lun, or ‘The Adjustment of Controversies’), Sacred Books of the East vol. 39
**Translator / edition:** James Legge, *The Texts of Taoism*, Part I (1891)
**Source URL:** https://www.sacred-texts.com/tao/sbe39/sbe39123.htm
**Nearby words (proof of page-read):** before: "and they are all before him as doing so." — after: "Lî Kî was a daughter of the border Warden"
**Why rare/valuable:** Far less posted than the butterfly dream; death reframed as misrecognized homecoming — cross-tradition depth in under 280 chars of sense.

### 3
**Quote:** He, who loves God, cannot endeavour that God should love him in return.
**Philosopher:** Benedictus de Spinoza
**Work + location:** *Ethics*, Part V, Proposition XIX
**Translator / edition:** R. H. M. Elwes; Project Gutenberg #3800

**Why rare/valuable:** Ice-cold and almost never on posters; love without bargain — rarer than the free-man / blessedness lines and deeper as a spiritual paradox.

### 4
**Quote:** For truly I believe that Ill Fortune is of more use to men than Good Fortune. For Good Fortune, when she wears the guise of happiness, and most seems to caress, is always lying; Ill Fortune is always truthful, since, in changing, she shows her inconstancy.
**Philosopher:** Boethius (Anicius Manlius Severinus Boethius)

**Why rare/valuable:** Medieval classic almost never mined for social posts; adversity as truth-teller — dense, memorable, non-cliché Stoicism.

  --ink:#f3e7cc; --ink-dim:#cbb994; --ink-faint:#9d8e72;
  --iron:#2b2a2c; --iron-hi:#55525a;
  --ruby:#e0115f; --ruby-deep:#6d0727; --sapphire:#2f6bff; --sapphire-deep:#0b1f66;
  --emerald:#1fc37a; --emerald-deep:#065034;
  --serif: Georgia, 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;color-scheme:dark}
body{
  margin:0; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--serif); font-size:17px; line-height:1.6;
  background-color:#1a1714;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 45% at 50% 0%, rgba(255,160,60,.16), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 60% at 0% 40%, rgba(255,120,30,.10), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 60% at 100% 40%, rgba(255,120,30,.10), transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.55) 100%),
    url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width%3D%27220%27%20height%3D%27220%27%3E%3Cfilter%20id%3D%27n%27%3E%3CfeTurbulence%20type%3D%27fractalNoise%27%20baseFrequency%3D%27.85%27%20numOctaves%3D%273%27%20stitchTiles%3D%27stitch%27/%3E%3CfeColorMatrix%20values%3D%270%200%200%200%200%20%200%200%200%200%200%20%200%200%200%200%200%20%200%200%200%20.55%200%27/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27220%27%20height%3D%27220%27%20filter%3D%27url%28%23n%29%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E"),
    url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%2780%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%2780%27%20fill%3D%27%23211d1a%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%272%27%20y%3D%272%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%232a2521%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2782%27%20y%3D%272%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%2325211d%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%27-38%27%20y%3D%2742%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%2327221e%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2742%27%20y%3D%2742%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%232c2622%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%27122%27%20y%3D%2742%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%2327221e%27/%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%27M0%200.5H160M0%2040.5H160M0.5%200V40M80.5%200V40M40.5%2040V80M120.5%2040V80%27%20stroke%3D%27%230d0b0a%27%20stroke-width%3D%273%27%20fill%3D%27none%27/%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%27M2%203H78M82%203H158M42%2043H118M122%2043H160M0%2043H38%27%20stroke%3D%27%233a332d%27%20stroke-width%3D%271%27%20opacity%3D%27.6%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  background-attachment: fixed, fixed, fixed, fixed, scroll, scroll;
}
a{color:var(--gold)}
a:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-hi); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-9999px}
.skip:focus{left:12px;top:12px;background:#000;color:var(--gold);padding:8px 12px;z-index:10}

/* ---------------- gate / portcullis header ---------------- */
.gate{position:relative; padding:0 16px; text-align:center}
.battlements{
  height:46px; max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #35302b 0 64px, transparent 64px 104px);
  border-bottom:4px solid #120f0d;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 -2px 0 #4a423a);
}
.wall{
  position:relative; max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:34px 20px 40px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#35302b,#2a2622 60%,#221e1b);
  border-left:4px solid #120f0d; border-right:4px solid #120f0d;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}
.wall::before{ /* block lines on the wall */
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:.55;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%2780%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%2780%27%20fill%3D%27%23211d1a%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%272%27%20y%3D%272%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%232a2521%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2782%27%20y%3D%272%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%2325211d%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%27-38%27%20y%3D%2742%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%2327221e%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2742%27%20y%3D%2742%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%232c2622%27/%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%27122%27%20y%3D%2742%27%20width%3D%2776%27%20height%3D%2736%27%20fill%3D%27%2327221e%27/%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%27M0%200.5H160M0%2040.5H160M0.5%200V40M80.5%200V40M40.5%2040V80M120.5%2040V80%27%20stroke%3D%27%230d0b0a%27%20stroke-width%3D%273%27%20fill%3D%27none%27/%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%27M2%203H78M82%203H158M42%2043H118M122%2043H160M0%2043H38%27%20stroke%3D%27%233a332d%27%20stroke-width%3D%271%27%20opacity%3D%27.6%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E"); mix-blend-mode:multiply;
}
.arch{
  position:relative; z-index:1; margin:0 auto; max-width:760px; min-height:330px;
  border:22px solid #4a423a; border-bottom:none;
  border-radius: 380px 380px 0 0 / 300px 300px 0 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 55% at 50% 70%, rgba(255,186,90,.38), rgba(120,60,10,.15) 55%, transparent 75%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#0b0907,#1b120a);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #1a1613, inset 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.85), 0 0 0 3px #1a1613;
  overflow:hidden;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end; align-items:center;
  padding: 120px 24px 34px;
}
.arch::after{ /* voussoir joints */
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:-22px; border-radius:inherit; pointer-events:none;
  background: repeating-conic-gradient(from -90deg at 50% 100%, transparent 0 8.5deg, rgba(0,0,0,.55) 8.5deg 9deg);
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, transparent 0 calc(100% - 26px), #000 calc(100% - 25px));
          mask: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, transparent 0 calc(100% - 26px), #000 calc(100% - 25px));
}
.portcullis{
  position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:0; height:100%; z-index:0; pointer-events:none;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 30px, var(--iron) 30px 40px, var(--iron-hi) 40px 41px, transparent 41px 70px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 46px, var(--iron) 46px 56px, var(--iron-hi) 56px 57px, transparent 57px 92px);
  transform: translateY(-64%);
  animation: lift 2.4s cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.2,1) .2s both;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.7));
}
.portcullis::after{ /* spikes */
  content:""; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-22px; height:22px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--iron) 0 35%, transparent 35%) 0 0/70px 22px repeat-x,
    linear-gradient(225deg, var(--iron) 0 35%, transparent 35%) 0 0/70px 22px repeat-x;
  background-position: 0 0, 0 0;
  -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 25px, #000 25px 46px, transparent 46px 70px);
          mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 25px, #000 25px 46px, transparent 46px 70px);
}
@keyframes lift{ from{transform:translateY(-8%)} to{transform:translateY(-64%)} }
.gate h1{
  position:relative; z-index:2; margin:0; line-height:1.05;
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 7vw, 4.6rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.03em;
  color:var(--gold);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold-hi) 0%, var(--gold) 40%, var(--gold-lo) 75%, #f6d98a 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #3a2506) drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(255,190,80,.45));
}
.gate .subtitle{
  position:relative; z-index:2; margin:.7rem 0 0; font-style:italic;
  font-size:clamp(1rem,2.4vw,1.25rem); color:var(--ink); text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000;
}
.gate .crest{position:relative; z-index:2; font-size:.85rem; letter-spacing:.35em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-dim); margin-bottom:.5rem}

/* torches */
.torch{position:absolute; top:150px; width:22px; height:120px; z-index:3}
.torch.left{left:calc(50% - 470px)} .torch.right{right:calc(50% - 470px)}
.torch .stick{position:absolute; bottom:0; left:6px; width:10px; height:78px; border-radius:2px 2px 4px 4px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3b2414,#6b4426 50%,#2b190d)}
.torch .stick::before{content:""; position:absolute; top:-6px; left:-5px; width:20px; height:12px; border-radius:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(#5a5458,#222)}
.torch .flame{position:absolute; bottom:80px; left:-3px; width:28px; height:42px;
  border-radius:50% 50% 45% 45% / 62% 62% 38% 38%;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 78%, #fff6c9 0 18%, #ffcf4a 32%, #ff8a1e 60%, rgba(255,60,0,0) 78%);
  transform-origin:50% 100%; animation:flicker 1.7s infinite alternate ease-in-out}
.torch .glow{position:absolute; bottom:40px; left:-110px; width:240px; height:240px; border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,170,60,.33), rgba(255,120,30,.10) 45%, transparent 70%);
  animation:glow 2.3s infinite alternate ease-in-out}
.torch.right .flame{animation-duration:1.9s; animation-delay:-.6s}
.torch.right .glow{animation-duration:2.7s; animation-delay:-1s}
@keyframes flicker{
  0%{transform:scale(1,1) skewX(0)} 25%{transform:scale(.93,1.08) skewX(-3deg)}
  50%{transform:scale(1.05,.95) skewX(2deg)} 75%{transform:scale(.97,1.1) skewX(-1deg)} 100%{transform:scale(1.02,.97) skewX(3deg)}
}
@keyframes glow{ from{opacity:.75; transform:scale(.96)} to{opacity:1; transform:scale(1.04)} }

/* nav */
.halls{max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:10px;
  padding:16px; background:#171310; border:4px solid #120f0d; border-top:none}
.halls a{text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.92rem; letter-spacing:.06em; padding:6px 14px;
  border:1px solid #5a4422; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(#241c13,#18120c)}
.halls a:hover{color:var(--gold-hi); border-color:var(--gold); box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(232,194,106,.25)}

main{max-width:1200px; margin:0 auto; padding:10px 18px 60px}

/* assay plaque */
.plaque{
  max-width:820px; margin:38px auto 10px; padding:22px 28px; text-align:center; position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a2c14,#22190c 60%,#2f230f);
  border:2px solid var(--gold-lo); border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #1a1209, inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(232,194,106,.35), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}
.plaque h2{margin:0 0 .4rem; font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:.3em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gold)}
.plaque p{margin:.3rem 0} .plaque .rule{font-size:1.15rem; font-style:italic}
.plaque .from-pouch{color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.92rem}
.plaque::before,.plaque::after{content:""; position:absolute; top:50%; width:12px; height:12px; margin-top:-6px; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, var(--gold-hi), var(--gold-lo) 60%, #3a2506)}
.plaque::before{left:10px} .plaque::after{right:10px}

/* rooms */
.room{margin-top:64px; scroll-margin-top:16px}
.room-head{text-align:center; margin-bottom:26px}
.room-head h2{
  display:inline-block; margin:0; padding:10px 34px; font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.6vw,2.2rem); letter-spacing:.06em;
  color:var(--gold-hi); text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,190,80,.35), 0 2px 0 #000;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a332d,#25201c); border:3px solid #120f0d; border-radius:6px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #5a5048, 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
.room-head h2::before,.room-head h2::after{content:"\2726"; color:var(--gold); font-size:.6em; vertical-align:middle; margin:0 .6em}
.room-head p{margin:.7rem auto 0; max-width:720px; color:var(--ink-dim); font-style:italic}

/* cards (shared) */
.card{
  position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; padding:26px 24px 20px;
  border-radius:14px; color:var(--ink);
  background:linear-gradient(170deg, rgba(48,40,32,.96), rgba(24,19,15,.97));
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.quote{margin:0; font-family:var(--serif); font-size:1.18rem; line-height:1.55; color:#fbf1d6; position:relative}
.quote p{margin:0}
.quote p::before{content:"\201C"; color:var(--gold); font-size:1.6em; line-height:0; vertical-align:-.32em; margin-right:.08em}
.quote p::after{content:"\201D"; color:var(--gold); font-size:1.6em; line-height:0; vertical-align:-.32em; margin-left:.05em}
.who{margin:0; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold); font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:.02em}
.who::before{content:"\2014\00a0"}
.meta{margin:0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:4px 12px; font-size:.93rem; color:var(--ink-dim)}
.meta dt{color:var(--ink-faint); font-variant:small-caps; letter-spacing:.06em}
.meta dd{margin:0}
.card-foot{margin-top:auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px}
.source{
  align-self:flex-start; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; text-decoration:none; font-size:.92rem;
  padding:6px 14px; border-radius:999px; color:#1d1304; font-weight:700;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-hi),var(--gold) 45%,var(--gold-lo));
  box-shadow:0 2px 0 #3a2506, 0 0 10px rgba(232,194,106,.25);
}
.source:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
.source .host{font-weight:400; opacity:.75; font-size:.85em; word-break:break-all}
details.proof{border-top:1px dashed rgba(232,194,106,.35); padding-top:8px}
details.proof summary{cursor:pointer; color:var(--gold); font-variant:small-caps; letter-spacing:.08em; list-style:none}
details.proof summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details.proof summary::before{content:"\25B8"; display:inline-block; margin-right:.45em; transition:transform .2s}
details.proof[open] summary::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.proof-body{margin-top:10px; padding:12px 14px; border-radius:8px; font-size:.93rem; color:var(--ink-dim);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.35); border:1px solid rgba(232,194,106,.18)}
.proof-body h4{margin:0 0 4px; color:var(--ink); font-size:.85rem; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase}
.proof-body p{margin:0 0 8px}
.proof-body .lbl{color:var(--gold); font-style:italic}
.proof-body .why{margin-top:10px}

/* crown vault: gem cards */
.crown{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:26px; align-items:stretch}
.gem-card{border:2px solid var(--g); padding-top:84px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 0 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--g) 40%, transparent), 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.7), inset 0 0 40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--g) 14%, transparent);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 40% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--g) 22%, transparent), transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(170deg, rgba(48,40,32,.97), rgba(20,16,13,.98));
}
.gem-card .quote{font-size:1.3rem}
.ruby{--g:var(--ruby); --gd:var(--ruby-deep)}
.sapphire{--g:var(--sapphire); --gd:var(--sapphire-deep)}
.emerald{--g:var(--emerald); --gd:var(--emerald-deep)}
.setting{position:absolute; top:-30px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:96px; height:96px; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--gold-hi), var(--gold) 35%, var(--gold-lo) 70%, var(--gold-deep));
  box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.7), inset 0 -3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5); display:grid; place-items:center}
.gem{width:62px; height:62px; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  clip-path:polygon(50% 0, 100% 38%, 82% 100%, 18% 100%, 0 38%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 0 38%, rgba(255,255,255,.75) 46%, transparent 54% 100%) no-repeat,
    conic-gradient(from 200deg at 50% 45%, var(--gd), var(--g), #fff 18%, var(--g) 26%, var(--gd) 40%, var(--g) 55%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--g) 50%, #fff) 66%, var(--gd) 80%, var(--g) 92%, var(--gd));
  background-size:250% 100%, 100% 100%; background-position:160% 0, 0 0;
  animation:shimmer 5s infinite ease-in-out;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--g))}
.gem::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 0 38%, transparent 38%),
             linear-gradient(60deg, transparent 49%, rgba(0,0,0,.25) 50%, transparent 51%),
             linear-gradient(-60deg, transparent 49%, rgba(0,0,0,.25) 50%, transparent 51%);
  mix-blend-mode:overlay}
.sapphire .gem{animation-delay:-1.6s} .emerald .gem{animation-delay:-3.2s}
@keyframes shimmer{ 0%,60%{background-position:160% 0,0 0} 85%,100%{background-position:-60% 0,0 0} }
.rank-tag{position:absolute; top:14px; right:16px; font-size:.78rem; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--g); filter:brightness(1.5)}
.gem-name{position:absolute; top:14px; left:16px; font-size:.78rem; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint)}

/* gold hall: coin cards */
.hall{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(330px,1fr)); gap:24px}
.coin-card{border:1px solid rgba(232,194,106,.45); padding-top:30px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, rgba(232,194,106,.14), transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(170deg, rgba(46,38,28,.97), rgba(22,18,14,.98))}
.coin-card .head{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px}
.coin{flex:none; width:58px; height:58px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center;
  font-weight:700; font-size:1.05rem; color:#4a3008; text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,240,190,.7);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 58%, rgba(90,60,10,.55) 59% 61%, transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #fff4c4, var(--gold) 38%, var(--gold-lo) 72%, var(--gold-deep));
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #b8892f, 0 0 0 4px #5a3c0c, 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.6), inset 0 -3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.coin-card .head .who{flex:1}

/* new finds tower */
.tower{max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; position:relative; padding:20px 0}
.tower::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:28px; top:0; bottom:0; width:6px; border-radius:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(#5a4422,#2a2014)}
.find{position:relative; margin:0 0 22px 70px; padding:20px 22px; border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(36,44,58,.95), rgba(18,20,28,.97));
  border:1px solid rgba(140,170,255,.35); box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.find .num{position:absolute; left:-62px; top:16px; width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:6px; display:grid; place-items:center;
  font-weight:700; color:#0d1530; background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #e9f0ff, #8fb0ff 55%, #3b5bb8);
  box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(120,160,255,.45), 0 0 0 3px #1a1613}
.find h3{margin:0 0 8px; font-size:1.15rem; color:#dfe8ff}
.find p{margin:0 0 12px; color:var(--ink-dim)}
.find p strong{color:var(--ink)}

/* gatehouse ledger */
.ledger{max-width:980px; margin:0 auto; padding:30px 32px; border-radius:6px; color:#2b1e0c;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(255,255,255,.35), transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 90%, rgba(120,80,20,.25), transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(170deg,#ecdcb0,#d9c28c 60%,#cdb175);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.65), inset 0 0 60px rgba(110,70,20,.35)}
.ledger h3{margin:0 0 12px; font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5b3a10; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(91,58,16,.4); padding-bottom:6px}
.ledger a{color:#7a3e05}
.updated{margin:0 0 22px; font-style:italic; color:#4a3412}
.updated strong{font-style:normal}
.log{list-style:none; margin:0 0 26px; padding:0; display:grid; gap:16px}
.log li{display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:14px; align-items:start}
.seal{width:70px; height:70px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; text-align:center;
  font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.12em; color:#fbe9d0; line-height:1.15;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.4), inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.18), inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.seal.sent{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #4fb07a, #1e6b43 60%, #0f3f26)}
.seal.held{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #d7524a, #8e1d17 60%, #5a0d09)}
.seal.other{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #a08a6a, #5d4b30)}
.log .entry p{margin:0 0 4px}
.log .q{font-size:1.08rem; font-style:italic}
.log .attr{font-size:.92rem; color:#4a3412}
.log .note{font-size:.82rem; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#6b4a1a}
.tally{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr)); gap:14px; margin:0 0 22px}
.count{text-align:center; padding:14px 10px; border-radius:10px; background:rgba(60,38,10,.12); border:1px solid rgba(91,58,16,.35)}
.count .n{display:block; font-size:2.2rem; font-weight:700; color:#6b4710; text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.count .l{font-size:.88rem; color:#4a3412}
details.melt summary{cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; color:#5b3a10}
details.melt ul{margin:10px 0 0; padding-left:20px; font-size:.93rem}
details.melt li{margin-bottom:6px}

footer{text-align:center; color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.85rem; padding:30px 16px 50px}

/* responsive */
@media (max-width: 1020px){
  .crown{grid-template-columns:1fr; max-width:680px; margin:0 auto; row-gap:52px}
  .torch.left{left:24px} .torch.right{right:24px}
}
@media (max-width: 760px){
  body{font-size:16px}
  .torch{display:none}
  .arch{min-height:260px; padding:90px 14px 26px; border-width:14px}
  .wall{padding:22px 10px 28px}
  .hall{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .card{padding-left:18px; padding-right:18px}
  .ledger{padding:22px 18px}
  .tower::before{left:18px}
  .find{margin-left:50px}
  .find .num{left:-48px; width:36px; height:36px}
  .seal{width:56px; height:56px; font-size:.62rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important}
  .portcullis{transform:translateY(-64%)}
}
